final: SELECT r.Name, r.byte_rate, r.byte_rate - a.overall_average as above_average FROM (SELECT mt.Name, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS REAL) as byte_rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name) r, (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) as overall_average FROM (SELECT CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / CAST(SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS REAL) as byte_rate FROM MediaType mt JOIN Track t ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId)) a WHERE r.byte_rate > a.overall_average ORDER BY r.byte_rate DESC
